pred-sql: WITH daily AS ( SELECT DATE(APPLYDATE) AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ods_pomp.lxpj_baseinfo_fld WHERE APPLYDATE BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2021-03-31' GROUP BY DATE(APPLYDATE) ), ma AS ( SELECT d, cnt, AVG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_7d_avg FROM daily ) SELECT d AS `峰值日`, cnt AS `当日发起量`, prev_7d_avg AS `前一周常态水平` FROM ma WHERE prev_7d_avg IS NOT NULL AND cnt > prev_7d_avg ORDER BY (cnt - prev_7d_avg) DESC;
Effective diff desc: gold_sql使用表ods_pomp.bus_baseinfo_fld和字段XSLXFQDATE，pred_sql使用表ods_pomp.lxpj_baseinfo_fld和字段APPLYDATE，来源表和字段均不同，数据范围也不同（gold_sql用<2021-04-01，pred_sql用<=2021-03-31）。

question: 在 2025 年 7 月 6 日到 7 日这个指定时期内，不同行业类型分别贡献了多少日累计流量，占总流量的比重是多少？
Gold-sql: WITH agg AS ( SELECT t.INDUSTRY_TYPE AS topic, SUM(t.DAILY_TOTAL_FLOW) AS amt FROM `IOC_NaturalGas`.`NG_GAS_REALTIME_USER_DATA` t WHERE STR_TO_DATE(t.DATA_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') >= '2025-07-06 00:00:00' AND STR_TO_DATE(t.DATA_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') < '2025-07-08 00:00:00' AND t.INDUSTRY_TYPE IS NOT NULL AND t.DAILY_TOTAL_FLOW IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.INDUSTRY_TYPE ), tot AS ( SELECT SUM(amt) AS total_amt FROM agg ) SELECT topic, amt, amt / NULLIF((SELECT total_amt FROM tot), 0) AS amt_share FROM agg ORDER BY amt_share DESC;
pred-sql: WITH daily_flow AS (SELECT INDUSTRY_TYPE, SUM(DAILY_TOTAL_FLOW) as total_flow FROM ng_gas_realtime_user_data WHERE DATA_DATE BETWEEN '2025-07-06' AND '2025-07-07' GROUP BY INDUSTRY_TYPE), total_sum AS (SELECT SUM(total_flow) as overall_total FROM daily_flow) SELECT df.INDUSTRY_TYPE, df.total_flow, (df.total_flow / ts.overall_total * 100) as percentage FROM daily_flow df, total_sum ts
Effective diff desc: pred_sql使用了表ng_gas_realtime_user_data，而正确表为NG_GAS_REALTIME_USER_DATA，表名完全不同，导致结果不一致。

Gold-sql: SELECT t.page_type, SUM(CASE WHEN t.begin_shift_time >= '2023-04-01 00:00:00' AND t.begin_shift_time < '2023-04-04 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS curr_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN t.begin_shift_time >= '2023-04-06 00:00:00' AND t.begin_shift_time < '2023-04-08 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prev_cnt, ( SUM(CASE WHEN t.begin_shift_time >= '2023-04-01 00:00:00' AND t.begin_shift_time < '2023-04-04 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.begin_shift_time >= '2023-04-06 00:00:00' AND t.begin_shift_time < '2023-04-08 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ) AS delta_cnt FROM Refinery.balance_information t WHERE t.page_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.page_type ORDER BY delta_cnt DESC LIMIT 3;
pred-sql:
SELECT
  b.page_type,
  SUM(CASE WHEN b.begin_shift_time >= '2023-04-01' AND b.begin_shift_time < '2023-04-04' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_20230401_20230403,
  SUM(CASE WHEN b.begin_shift_time >= '2023-04-06' AND b.begin_shift_time < '2023-04-08' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_20230406_20230407,
  SUM(CASE WHEN b.begin_shift_time >= '2023-04-06' AND b.begin_shift_time < '2023-04-08' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
  SUM(CASE WHEN b.begin_shift_time >= '2023-04-01' AND b.begin_shift_time < '2023-04-04' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS change_value
FROM balance_information b
WHERE b.page_type IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    (b.begin_shift_time >= '2023-04-01' AND b.begin_shift_time < '2023-04-04')
    OR
    (b.begin_shift_time >= '2023-04-06' AND b.begin_shift_time < '2023-04-08')
  )
GROUP BY b.page_type
ORDER BY ABS(change_value) DESC
LIMIT 3
Effective diff desc: Pred SQL与Gold SQL的执行结果差异： 1. 计算字段`change_value`为`cnt_20230406_20230407 - cnt_20230401_20230403`，与Gold中的`delta_cnt`(curr_cnt - prev_cnt)符号相反。 2. 过滤条件增加了只保留`begin_shift_time`在两个统计区间内的记录，会排除Gold中那些完全不在这些区间内、统计值为0的`page_type`。 3. 排序使用`ABS(change_value) DESC`，而Gold排序使用`delta_cnt DESC`，导致选取前三的判定标准不同（一个按绝对值、一个按原值），可能选出不同的`page_type`或顺序不同。

pred-sql:
WITH daily_cnt AS (
    SELECT DATE(b.begin_shift_time) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS day_record_cnt
    FROM balance_information b
    WHERE b.begin_shift_time >= '2023-04-01 00:00:00'
      AND b.begin_shift_time < '2023-04-04 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY DATE(b.begin_shift_time)
)
SELECT 
    d.stat_date,
    d.day_record_cnt,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*) / 7.0
        FROM balance_information b2
        WHERE b2.begin_shift_time >= DATE_SUB(d.stat_date, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
          AND b2.begin_shift_time < d.stat_date
    ) AS prior_7d_avg_record_cnt,
    d.day_record_cnt - (
        SELECT COUNT(*) / 7.0
        FROM balance_information b3
        WHERE b3.begin_shift_time >= DATE_SUB(d.stat_date, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
          AND b3.begin_shift_time < d.stat_date
    ) AS uplift_vs_prior_7d_avg
FROM daily_cnt d
ORDER BY uplift_vs_prior_7d_avg DESC
LIMIT 3
Effective diff desc: Pred SQL与Gold SQL计算前7天平均值的方式不同，导致执行结果不一致。Gold SQL先按天聚合得到每天的记录数cnt，然后用窗口函数AVG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)计算前7天（按存在的日期行，最多7行）每天记录数的平均值；而Pred SQL直接用原始表统计前7天内的总记录数除以7.0，这等价于总记录数的日均值，而非每日记录数的平均值。在日期有缺失时（某天无记录），Gold SQL窗口只对已有日期的行求平均，Pred SQL的除法始终除7，会低估平均值。此外，Pred SQL未排除prev_7d_avg为NULL的情况（若前7天无记录，子查询得0，可能仍参与排序），筛选条件也与Gold SQL不完全对应。因此两者结果不同。

pred-sql: WITH daily_counts AS ( SELECT DATE(b.begin_shift_time) AS dt, COUNT(*) AS daily_cnt FROM balance_information b WHERE b.begin_shift_time >= '2023-03-25 00:00:00' AND b.begin_shift_time < '2023-04-04 00:00:00' GROUP BY DATE(b.begin_shift_time) ), prev_week_avg AS ( SELECT AVG(daily_cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM daily_counts WHERE dt >= '2023-03-25' AND dt <= '2023-03-31' ) SELECT dc.dt, dc.daily_cnt, pw.avg_cnt, (dc.daily_cnt - pw.avg_cnt) AS exceed_amount FROM daily_counts dc CROSS JOIN prev_week_avg pw WHERE dc.dt >= '2023-04-01' AND dc.dt <= '2023-04-03' AND dc.daily_cnt > pw.avg_cnt ORDER BY exceed_amount DESC LIMIT 3
Effective diff desc: gold_sql使用窗口函数计算每个日期前7天的移动平均作为常态水平，而pred_sql错误地使用固定的一周(3月25-31日)全局平均作为常态水平，且pred_sql的CROSS JOIN会导致所有日期与同一平均值比较，逻辑不等价

WITH node_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        ni.NODE_ALIAS AS node_alias,
        COUNT(*) AS total_records
    FROM 
        rpt_t_daily_refinery_unit ru
    JOIN 
        node_information ni ON ru.node_code = ni.NODE_ID
    GROUP BY 
        ni.NODE_ALIAS
    HAVING 
        COUNT(*) > 50

    SELECT 
        ni.NODE_ALIAS,
        ru.inout_type,
        COUNT(*) AS type_count
    FROM 
        rpt_t_daily_refinery_unit ru
    JOIN 
        node_information ni ON ru.node_code = ni.NODE_ID

        ni.NODE_ALIAS IN (SELECT node_alias FROM node_counts)

        ni.NODE_ALIAS, ru.inout_type
),

    SELECT 
        tc.NODE_ALIAS,
        MAX(tc.type_count) AS max_type_count
    FROM 
        type_counts tc
    GROUP BY 
        tc.NODE_ALIAS
)
SELECT 
    mc.NODE_ALIAS AS node_alias,
    mc.max_type_count / nc.total_records AS concentration_ratio
FROM 
    max_counts mc
JOIN 
    node_counts nc ON mc.NODE_ALIAS = nc.node_alias
ORDER BY 
    concentration_ratio DESC
LIMIT 3

pred-sql: SELECT t.node_code, MAX(type_cnt) AS hit_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_cnt, CAST(MAX(type_cnt) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS hit_ratio FROM rpt_t_daily_refinery_unit t JOIN (SELECT node_code, inout_type, COUNT(*) AS type_cnt FROM rpt_t_daily_refinery_unit WHERE node_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY node_code, inout_type) sub ON t.node_code = sub.node_code WHERE t.node_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.node_code HAVING COUNT(*) > 50 ORDER BY hit_ratio DESC LIMIT 3;
Effective diff desc: 选取计算逻辑不同

question: 我想看每类装置类型下，设计能力最高的装置名称分别是谁。
Gold-sql: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT t.UNIT_TYPE_ID AS topic, t.UNIT_NAME AS entity_name, t.CAPACITY AS qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.UNIT_TYPE_ID ORDER BY t.CAPACITY DESC, t.UNIT_NAME) AS rn FROM Refinery.pm_unit_t t WHERE t.UNIT_TYPE_ID IS NOT NULL AND t.UNIT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND t.CAPACITY IS NOT NULL ) SELECT topic, entity_name, qty FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY qty DESC;
pred-sql: SELECT t1.UNIT_NAME, t1.UNIT_TYPE_ID, t1.CAPACITY FROM pm_unit_t t1 JOIN (SELECT UNIT_TYPE_ID, MAX(CAPACITY) as max_capacity FROM pm_unit_t GROUP BY UNIT_TYPE_ID) t2 ON t1.UNIT_TYPE_ID = t2.UNIT_TYPE_ID AND t1.CAPACITY = t2.max_capacity
Effective diff desc: pred_sql使用子查询取最大容量后连接，当存在并列最高设计能力时会返回多条记录；gold_sql通过ROW_NUMBER按容量降序和名称排序取rn=1，每个类型仅返回一条记录

    SELECT UNIT_TYPE_ID, MAX(CAPACITY) AS max_capacity

pred-sql: SELECT p.payment_type, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-06-01 13:00:00' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-06-01 15:00:00' THEN o.order_id END) AS curr_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-06-01 17:00:00' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-06-01 19:00:00' THEN o.order_id END) AS prev_cnt, ( COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-06-01 13:00:00' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-06-01 15:00:00' THEN o.order_id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-06-01 17:00:00' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-06-01 19:00:00' THEN o.order_id END) ) AS delta_cnt FROM OLIST_ORDERS o JOIN OLIST_ORDER_PAYMENTS p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE p.payment_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.payment_type ORDER BY ABS(delta_cnt) DESC LIMIT 3;
Effective diff desc: 存在多处关键差异：1) pred_sql使用COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)而gold_sql使用SUM(1)，统计粒度不同；2) pred_sql按ABS(delta_cnt)排序而gold_sql按delta_cnt DESC排序，导致升降温判断方向丢失；3) pred_sql缺少CAST AS DATETIME类型转换；4) pred_sql表名缺少库名前缀；5) pred_sql有WHERE payment_type IS NOT NULL过滤而gold_sql没有

pred-sql: WITH a AS ( SELECT p.payment_type, COUNT(*) AS qty_a FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_order_payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-06-01 13:00:00' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-06-01 15:00:00' GROUP BY p.payment_type ), b AS ( SELECT p.payment_type, COUNT(*) AS qty_b FROM olist_orders o JOIN olist_order_payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-06-01 17:00:00' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-06-01 19:00:00' GROUP BY p.payment_type ) SELECT COALESCE(a.payment_type, b.payment_type) AS payment_type, IFNULL(a.qty_a, 0) AS qty_a, IFNULL(b.qty_b, 0) AS qty_b, IFNULL(b.qty_b, 0) - IFNULL(a.qty_a, 0) AS diff FROM a LEFT JOIN b ON a.payment_type = b.payment_type UNION SELECT COALESCE(a.payment_type, b.payment_type) AS payment_type, IFNULL(a.qty_a, 0) AS qty_a, IFNULL(b.qty_b, 0) AS qty_b, IFNULL(b.qty_b, 0) - IFNULL(a.qty_a, 0) AS diff FROM b LEFT JOIN a ON a.payment_type = b.payment_type ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 3

question: 在 2018 年 5 月 23 日下午 3 点到 5 点这个时间窗内，各支付方式分别贡献了多少回款，占总回款的比重是多少？
Gold-sql: WITH agg AS ( SELECT op.payment_type AS topic, SUM(op.payment_value) AS amt FROM BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE.OLIST_ORDER_PAYMENTS op JOIN BRAZILIAN_E_COMMERCE.OLIST_ORDERS o ON op.order_id = o.order_id WHERE CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATETIME) >= '2018-05-23 15:00:00' AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATETIME) < '2018-05-23 17:00:00' GROUP BY op.payment_type ), tot AS ( SELECT SUM(amt) AS total_amt FROM agg ) SELECT topic, amt, amt / NULLIF((SELECT total_amt FROM tot), 0) AS amt_share FROM agg ORDER BY amt_share DESC;
pred-sql: WITH payment_agg AS ( SELECT op.payment_type, SUM(op.payment_value) AS total_payment FROM olist_orders oo JOIN olist_order_payments op ON oo.order_id = op.order_id WHERE CAST(oo.order_approved_at AS DATETIME) >= '2018-05-23 15:00:00' AND CAST(oo.order_approved_at AS DATETIME) < '2018-05-23 17:00:00' GROUP BY op.payment_type ), total_payment AS ( SELECT SUM(total_payment) AS grand_total FROM payment_agg ) SELECT pa.payment_type, pa.total_payment, pa.total_payment / NULLIF((SELECT grand_total FROM total_payment), 0) AS payment_share FROM payment_agg pa ORDER BY pa.total_payment DESC
Effective diff desc: 时间过滤条件不同：Gold使用order_purchase_timestamp，Pred使用order_approved_at，导致过滤出的订单不同；排序不同：Gold按占比降序，Pred按金额降序。

question: 我想比较 2019 年 3 月 1 日到 10 日和 3 月 20 日到 31 日这两个时间段里，不同促销大类的销售记录数差异，看看哪些活动类型在前一段时间比后一段时间更热，先给我前 3 个。
Gold-sql: SELECT p.promo_category, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(s.time_id AS DATE) >= '2019-03-01' AND CAST(s.time_id AS DATE) < '2019-03-11' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS curr_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(s.time_id AS DATE) >= '2019-03-20' AND CAST(s.time_id AS DATE) < '2019-04-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prev_cnt, ( SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(s.time_id AS DATE) >= '2019-03-01' AND CAST(s.time_id AS DATE) < '2019-03-11' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(s.time_id AS DATE) >= '2019-03-20' AND CAST(s.time_id AS DATE) < '2019-04-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ) AS delta_cnt FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.SALES s JOIN COMPLEX_ORACLE.PROMOTIONS p ON s.promo_id = p.promo_id GROUP BY p.promo_category ORDER BY delta_cnt DESC LIMIT 3;
pred-sql: WITH sales_period_1 AS (SELECT s.promo_id, COUNT(*) AS sales_count FROM sales s JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id WHERE t.calendar_month_number = 3 AND t.calendar_year = 2019 AND t.day_number_in_month BETWEEN 1 AND 10 GROUP BY s.promo_id), sales_period_2 AS (SELECT s.promo_id, COUNT(*) AS sales_count FROM sales s JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id WHERE t.calendar_month_number = 3 AND t.calendar_year = 2019 AND t.day_number_in_month BETWEEN 20 AND 31 GROUP BY s.promo_id), promo_sales_diff AS (SELECT p.promo_category, IFNULL(sp1.sales_count, 0) - IFNULL(sp2.sales_count, 0) AS difference FROM promotions p LEFT JOIN sales_period_1 sp1 ON p.promo_id = sp1.promo_id LEFT JOIN sales_period_2 sp2 ON p.promo_id = sp2.promo_id) SELECT promo_category, difference FROM promo_sales_diff WHERE difference > 0 ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 3
Effective diff desc: Pred SQL多了WHERE difference > 0过滤条件，只返回差值大于0的promo_category，而Gold SQL返回所有类别；Pred SQL仅选择两列(promo_category, difference)，Gold SQL选择四列(promo_category, curr_cnt, prev_cnt, delta_cnt)；Pred SQL使用LEFT JOIN保留所有promo，Gold SQL使用JOIN仅保留有匹配的promo，结合过滤后导致结果集不同。

pred-sql: WITH agg AS ( SELECT p.promo_category AS topic, SUM(s.amount_sold) AS amt FROM sales s JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id JOIN promotions p ON s.promo_id = p.promo_id WHERE t.calendar_year = 2019 AND t.calendar_month_number = 3 AND t.day_number_in_month BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND p.promo_category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.promo_category ), tot AS ( SELECT SUM(amt) AS total_amt FROM agg ) SELECT topic, amt, amt / NULLIF((SELECT total_amt FROM tot), 0) AS amt_share FROM agg ORDER BY amt_share DESC
Effective diff desc: pred_sql使用了times表连接过滤日期，而gold_sql直接对sales.time_id做日期范围过滤，且pred_sql额外增加了p.promo_category IS NOT NULL过滤条件，两者数据源和过滤逻辑不同

question: 我想在 2019 年 3 月 20 日到 31 日这段时间里，找出销售记录数高于此前一段时间平均水平的日期，先看差值最大的 3 天。
Gold-sql: WITH daily AS ( SELECT DATE( CAST(s.time_id AS DATE)) AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.SALES s JOIN COMPLEX_ORACLE.CUSTOMERS c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE CAST(s.time_id AS DATE) >= '2019-03-20' AND CAST(s.time_id AS DATE) < '2019-04-01' GROUP BY d ), ma AS ( SELECT d, cnt, AVG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_7d_avg FROM daily ) SELECT d, cnt, prev_7d_avg FROM ma WHERE prev_7d_avg IS NOT NULL AND cnt > prev_7d_avg ORDER BY (cnt - prev_7d_avg) DESC LIMIT 3;
pred-sql: WITH avg_sales_before AS (SELECT AVG(s.quantity_sold) as avg_quantity FROM sales s JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id WHERE t.week_ending_day >= '2019-03-01' AND t.week_ending_day < '2019-03-20'), avg_sales_target AS (SELECT t.week_ending_day, s.quantity_sold - (SELECT avg_quantity FROM avg_sales_before) AS diff FROM sales s JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id WHERE t.week_ending_day >= '2019-03-20' AND t.week_ending_day <= '2019-03-31') SELECT week_ending_day, diff FROM avg_sales_target WHERE diff > 0 ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 3
Effective diff desc: 表结构不同（Gold用CUSTOMERS表，Pred用times表）、时间粒度不同（Gold按天，Pred按week_ending_day）、时间范围不同（Gold从2019-03-20到2019-03-31，Pred基线用前19天平均值）、计算逻辑不同（Gold用7天滑动平均，Pred用固定时段平均值）、聚合不同（Gold按天count行数，Pred不聚合直接取单行quantity_sold差值）、输出列不同（Gold输出d,cnt,prev_7d_avg，Pred输出week_ending_day,diff），结果完全不具有可比性。

pred-sql: WITH agg AS ( SELECT c.channel_class AS topic, c.channel_desc AS entity_name, SUM(s.quantity_sold) AS amt FROM sales s JOIN channels c ON s.channel_id = c.channel_id WHERE c.channel_class IS NOT NULL AND c.channel_desc IS NOT NULL AND s.quantity_sold IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.channel_class, c.channel_desc ), ranked AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY topic ORDER BY amt DESC, entity_name) AS rn FROM agg ) SELECT topic, entity_name, amt FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY amt DESC
Effective diff desc: pred_sql相比gold_sql增加了非空过滤条件（WHERE c.channel_class IS NOT NULL AND c.channel_desc IS NOT NULL AND s.quantity_sold IS NOT NULL），会过滤掉含有NULL值的记录，导致结果集可能不同；且表名缺少库名前缀（但不影响等价性），列别名qty改为amt不影响语义但过滤条件导致不等价

question: 我想看商品活跃留存：有多少个 SKU 在2018年的一季度和四季度都持续有销售记录？
Gold-sql: WITH a AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ms.product_id FROM ORACLE_SQL.MONTHLY_SALES ms WHERE STR_TO_DATE(ms.mth, '%Y-%m-%d') >= '2018-01-01' AND STR_TO_DATE(ms.mth, '%Y-%m-%d') < '2018-04-01' ), b AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ms.product_id FROM ORACLE_SQL.MONTHLY_SALES ms WHERE STR_TO_DATE(ms.mth, '%Y-%m-%d') >= '2018-10-01' AND STR_TO_DATE(ms.mth, '%Y-%m-%d') < '2019-01-01' ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS retained_entity_cnt FROM a JOIN b USING (product_id);
pred-sql: WITH a AS ( SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM monthly_sales WHERE mth BETWEEN '2018-01' AND '2018-03' ), b AS ( SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM monthly_sales WHERE mth BETWEEN '2018-10' AND '2018-12' ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS retained_sku_count FROM a JOIN b USING (product_id)
Effective diff desc: 过滤条件不同：Gold SQL使用STR_TO_DATE将mth转换为日期后比较，范围包括2018-01-01至2018-04-01之前和2018-10-01至2019-01-01之前，即完整的第一季度和第四季度；Pred SQL使用字符串BETWEEN '2018-01' AND '2018-03'及BETWEEN '2018-10' AND '2018-12'，字符串比较时月末日期（如2018-03-31、2018-12-31）可能不被包含，导致结果差异。

pred-sql: SELECT day FROM ( SELECT day, counter, AVG(counter) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS avg_prev_week FROM web_counter_hist WHERE day >= '2019-01-01' AND day <= '2019-06-30' ) AS subq WHERE avg_prev_week IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (counter - avg_prev_week) DESC LIMIT 3
Effective diff desc: Pred SQL仅输出了day字段，而Gold SQL输出了d、cnt和prev_7d_avg三个字段；结果集列数和内容均不一致，缺失了当日的访问计数和前期移动平均值信息，无法反映完整的对比关系。

question: 我想看哪些应用挂了最多页面编号，先把页面规模最大的 app 给我前 10 个。
Gold-sql: SELECT p.app_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.page_no) AS external_cnt FROM ORACLE_SQL.WEB_PAGES p GROUP BY p.app_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.page_no) > 1 ORDER BY external_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;
pred-sql: SELECT w.name, COUNT(wp.page_no) AS page_count FROM web_apps w JOIN web_pages wp ON w.id = wp.app_id GROUP BY w.id, w.name ORDER BY page_count DESC LIMIT 10

pred-sql: SELECT wa.name AS app_name, COUNT(wch.page_no) AS page_count FROM WEB_COUNTER_HIST wch JOIN WEB_APPS wa ON wch.app_id = wa.id GROUP BY wa.name ORDER BY page_count DESC LIMIT 10;
Effective diff desc: 数据源表不同(ORB_SQL.WEB_PAGES vs WEB_COUNTER_HIST+WEB_APPS)，聚合逻辑不同(COUNT DISTINCT vs COUNT)，过滤条件缺失(HAVING>1)，返回列不同(app_id vs app_name)

question: 我想看每个商品组下面最具代表性的产品名称分别是什么。
Gold-sql: WITH agg AS ( SELECT pg.name AS topic, p.name AS entity_name, COUNT(*) AS qty FROM ORACLE_SQL.PRODUCTS p JOIN ORACLE_SQL.PRODUCT_GROUPS pg ON p.group_id = pg.id GROUP BY pg.name, p.name ), ranked AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY topic ORDER BY qty DESC, entity_name) AS rn FROM agg ) SELECT topic, entity_name, qty FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY qty DESC;
pred-sql: WITH agg AS ( SELECT p.GROUP_ID AS topic, p.NAME AS entity_name, SUM(ms.qty) AS qty FROM products p JOIN monthly_sales ms ON p.ID = ms.product_id WHERE p.GROUP_ID IS NOT NULL AND p.NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.GROUP_ID, p.NAME ), ranked AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY topic ORDER BY qty DESC, entity_name) AS rn FROM agg ) SELECT topic, entity_name, qty FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY qty DESC
Effective diff desc: SELECT选取的字段不同（topic来源不同：Gold为pg.name即组名，Pred为p.GROUP_ID即数字ID）、使用的表连接不同（Gold关联PRODUCT_GROUPS和PRODUCTS，Pred关联PRODUCTS和monthly_sales）、聚合函数不同（Gold用COUNT(*)，Pred用SUM(ms.qty)）、过滤条件不同（Gold无显式过滤，Pred增加了p.GROUP_ID和p.NAME非空条件），导致执行结果完全不同。

因此两条 SQL 的执行结果完全不一致，Pred SQL 的“销售量”与 Gold SQL 的“计数”在含义和数值上均不同，无法替代原有逻辑。
